summary: Implement S1 static checkers for remaining 14 catalog standards

delivery.outcome: Implement deterministic, dependency-free S1 static conformance checkers for all 14 remaining STANDARDS_CATALOG packs (authority-lifecycle, repair-lifecycle, account-runtime, skills, status, performance, llm, dsl, env-dsl, code-dsl, nl-dsl-llm, nl-api-llm, poa, anonym) so 53/53 registered Wellmanifest standards execute concrete static checks without returning GOV-STANDARD-NOT-IMPLEMENTED.
nonGoals: Executing untrusted repository code or runtime daemons during static checks
Claiming S3/S4/S5 runtime conformance from S1 static validation

architecture.decision: Add bounded, symlink-refusing, duplicate-key-rejecting S1 checkers in src/wellman/catalog_pack_checkers.py and wire all 14 standards into ConformanceRunner.run_standard and ConformanceRunner.run_all.

validation.evidence: All 53/53 STANDARDS_CATALOG packs execute deterministic S1 checkers with positive, negative, and symlink-refusal coverage, while unknown/unimplemented future IDs remain fail-closed.
Governance gate and Wellman standards check pass with zero errors and clean git diff --check.
